name: smwsprites-one-ride-platform
title: "One Ride" Platform
description:
A platform on which Mario can ride to the left or right.
Once Mario jumps or steps off the platform, the platform falls off the screen.

Two config files are included:
oneride_plat_r.cfg -- Platform which goes to the right.
oneride_plat_l.cfg -- Platform which goes to the left.

Platform's direction is determined by extra property byte 1 of said cfg files.

In addition, a graphics file for SP4 is included, based off of GFX20.bin. The only difference is two little arrow graphics replacing some unused tiles.

Now PIXI compatible.
